purpose: Names the retained non-publication runs the manuscript is allowed to cite, and binds each one to the exact sample bytes it was computed from. A rerun writes a new directory and a new digest, so a paper number can never drift onto evidence nobody reviewed.

Refused-footprint ladder, both arms, one deployment each, one measured sample per cell. Bounded: rung 1 released exactly the corpus footprint (1 Result / 400 Dependency / 6 Outcome facts, scalar 799819/2); rungs 2-3 refused EXPOSURE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED at the reservation estimate, rungs 4-12 refused EXPOSURE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED (evidence span above the Dependency limit) with zero charge. Unlimited: all 12 rungs released their exact corpus footprints (up to 700,000 Dependency facts at 100k rows x 4 columns, client 534 ms). Every charge and scalar matched the frozen corpus rung for rung.

Benign agent-trace study, definitive run on the HAVING-fixed Gateway: the 27 unedited lowerable statements on one root per arm under the a-priori recipe budgets. Recipe arm: 21 accepted, 5 budget-independent policy refusals, exactly one budget refusal (q26 at position 19; the trace's novel Dependency union 1,456,837 exceeds the conservative recipe budget 1,450,000 by 0.47%). The x2 arm already eliminates every budget refusal (22 accepted, final union 1,456,837 Dependency facts); x4 identical. Cross-statement set-union accounting and HAVING/LIMIT positive-output semantics are visible in the per-step ledger deltas.
